standard_prerequisites.use: Formally smooth morphisms and their lifting criterion, formal smoothness of ring maps, and affine open covers; the local-to-global step is retained.

core_obligations: Record the implications following from the open-immersion stability of formal smoothness, including the immediate one.
Assemble formal smoothness of the morphism from the ring-map condition on one affine cover by passing along the cover.

proof_roadmap.step: Discharge the implications that follow from stability of formal smoothness under open immersions.
Prove the local-to-global implication from the ring-map condition on an affine cover.
Conclude formal smoothness of the morphism.

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that formal smoothness of a morphism of schemes is equivalent to three successively weaker local formulations: local formal smoothness on affine opens, the ring-map condition on every pair of compatible affine opens, and the same condition on one chosen affine cover of the target with affine covers of the preimages. The implications that require work are the local-to-global ones, where formal smoothness of the ring maps on a cover must be assembled into formal smoothness of the morphism, using the lifting criterion and affine localisation. Retained author proof at lines 3350-3415.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: this side assumes a morphism of schemes; the sibling assumes a morphism of algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: none - lemma-formally-smooth has the same conclusion on both sides.
Withdrawn as the special case; the algebraic-spaces side carries the count.
